information_flow: The first call receives every common input and emits one complete executable policy capsule. The second consumes that capsule and reopens anchor_policy and anchor_contract. The third consumes the resulting complete executable state and reopens task_constraints and loop_structure. The final call consumes the resulting complete executable closure and reopens task, candidate_hypothesis, and the nonadjacently recurrent anchor_contract edge. All other lineage edges remain unchanged.
name: Nonadjacent Contract Recurrence Relay
organization: four-call sequential lineage carrying one complete executable artifact under a single recurrent contract-authority edge

calls.objective: Reconcile the visible evidence and obligations into one complete executable policy artifact.
Consume the preceding complete artifact, reconcile it against the reentered anchor evidence and contract obligations, and emit one complete executable policy state.
Consume the preceding complete artifact, reconcile it against the reentered constraints and structural evidence, and emit one complete executable policy closure.
Consume the preceding complete artifact, reconcile terminal task and hypothesis evidence under the recurrent contract authority, and emit one complete policy.
